visualCharacteristics.summary: Row of tiles filled with a horizontal gradient; name top-left, stop names along the bottom
visualCharacteristics.purpose: brand gradient definitions painted from named colour stops

contentPattern.summary: 4 gradient tiles with name and colour stops
contentPattern.structure: one row per gradient; one cell: gradient name as h3, then a bulleted list of colour-stop names in order (e.g. Process Blue, Bright Blue, White)

usage: One row per gradient: heading with the gradient name, then a list of colour-stop names (brand colour names such as Process Blue, Bright Blue, White, or CSS colours). Painted as a 90deg linear gradient with evenly spread stops; stop labels sit along the bottom.

cells: Cell 1 (text): gradient name as heading (h3), then a list of colour stops in order (e.g. Process Blue, Bright Blue, White)

blockContent.behaviour: Block code maps the stop names to brand colours and paints a 90deg linear gradient, with the stops spread evenly; stop labels sit along the bottom.
